scope: Conservative user production policy and review hints, not a legal decision or exhaustive platform rules

rules.pattern: 国家级|最高级|最佳|最好|最大|最小|最高|最低|最强|最优|最先进|最安全|最耐用|最受欢迎|最保暖|最暖|最柔软|最舒适|最轻|最薄|最厚|最省钱|最畅销|最火|全网第一|销量第一|世界第一|全国第一|行业第一|第一品牌|第一选择|顶级|顶尖|极致|独一无二|独家首创|全网最低|史上最低|天花板|遥遥领先|独家专利|唯一指定|\bno\.?\s*1\b|\bnumber\s*one\b|\bthe\s+best\b
rules.action: Marketing defaults to no use. For specifications or usage limits review context and preserve verified values; do not auto-delete.

rules.pattern: 首创|首发|领先|第一|唯一|独家|销量冠军|销量领先|销售冠军|热销|爆款|万人好评|零差评|国家认证|国家免检|官方指定|权威认证|专家推荐|医生推荐|专利|检测报告
rules.action: Check source, scope, date and applicability; do not replace unsupported claims with another unsupported claim.

rules.pattern: 绝不|永不|永久|零风险|零刺激|零过敏|百分之百|100\s*[%％]\s*(?:防水|保暖|安全|有效|抗菌|杀菌)|不夹头|不掉毛|绝对安全|所有头围|任何头围
rules.action: Remove unsupported unconditional guarantees; a material percentage alone is not a prohibited claim.

rules.pattern: 恒温|蓄热|内热循环|升温|自发热|防风|防水|防泼水|触屏|抗菌|抑菌|杀菌|防过敏|亲肤无刺激|倍保暖|cyclic\s+warming|self[- ]heating|constant\s+temperature
rules.action: Check actual product evidence and conditions; ordinary functions are not automatically illegal. Check matching icons and all languages.

rules.pattern: 治疗冻疮|治疗关节炎|改善血液循环|促进血液循环|消炎|止痛|治疗|治愈|预防疾病
rules.action: Ordinary earmuff/glove copy must not imply disease treatment; other product categories require separate rules.

rules.pattern: 可机洗|可水洗|可烘干|误差\s*[0-9一二三]+\s*[-–至]\s*[0-9一二三]+\s*(?:cm|厘米)|最终解释权|概不退换|不退不换|以实物为准|仅供参考|个体有差异
rules.action: Verify care and tolerance sources; disclaimers cannot negate the main claim or legal consumer rights.

rules.pattern: 加微|加V|加v|微信|VX|V信|私下下单|私下交易|扫码下单|站外购买|二维码|https?://|www\.
rules.action: Review offsite trade, contact and QR purpose; do not remove genuine traceability/required instructions automatically.
